faq.a: The Brazil Pavilion is a large block of booths in the center-left of Hall A (west hall). ABIMAPI is on the official exhibitor list at booth 429 in that pavilion. Apex-Brasil and CECIE-X appear as map labels. Open the live Goeshow floorplan for the latest booth pins.

faq.q: Where is A Taste of the States?
faq.a: A Taste of the States is the large central Country of Honor pavilion in Hall B — the United States pavilion produced by NASDA with USDA FAS. It is the biggest U.S. showcase in show history (show copy: 22,200 sq ft / 165 companies). Look for it in the heart of Hall B, south of the Food Court.
Center Stage is the prominent orange reserved block in the heart of Hall B. From the main Entrance & Exit at the bottom center, walk straight into Hall B; the stage is mid-hall.
The Beverage Pavilion is at the top left of Hall A. Beverage Demo sits inside that pavilion. It is the main west-side landmark along the top of the floor.
The Food Court runs along the top edge of the floor, bridging Hall A and Hall B — a north-side landmark above the Taste of the States pavilion.
The Buyer's Lounge is the large orange reserved block on the far right edge of Hall C.

HapCor (labeled HapCor / HapLOr on the map) is in Hall B. The official exhibitor list places HapCor at booth 463, with many HapCor partner brands nearby. Use the live Goeshow map to pin the exact cluster.
Atlantic Grocery Supply is on the official exhibitor list at booth 1809 and is labeled in Hall C on the floorplan screenshot.

faq.q: How do I get from the entrance to the Brazil Pavilion?
faq.a: Enter at the bottom-center Entrance & Exit. Turn left (west) into Hall A, then walk toward the center-left of that hall. Brazil is a large labeled pavilion; Beverage Pavilion will be further up toward the top left.

faq.q: What do the booth colors mean?
faq.a: Goeshow legend from the captured floorplan: green = Sold, yellow = Pending, white = Available, orange = Reserved (stages, lounges, meeting areas). Most booths on the 2026 capture are green / sold.
